notes.title: Become a Bounty Hunter October 23, 2025
notes.content:
[p]It’s official, we have a launch date for Bounty Star: [b]October 23, 2025[/b]![/p][p]
[/p][p]Get ready to step into the Red Expanse as Clem, a broken but powerful ex-soldier who attempts to shed the guilt and shame of her past and become a legitimate force for good in the Red Expanse.[/p][p]
